supersedes: the v1 receipt at commit 6b338cd (n=12 holdout only, TABLE_REPORTED)
question: does the synthetic-corpus egress result survive REAL text?
why_not_the_mvp_queries: the MVP path is retrieve -> text -> backbone -> answer and carries NO typed labels. Running the typed head on MVP queries would require inventing labels, which this session refuses. Real committed prose with deterministic substring labels is the honest substitute.

method.prose: 992 unique sentences pooled from 19 committed design documents
method.typed_field: entity; label = the ONE entity the sentence mentions, by deterministic substring match

caveats_stated_against_the_verdict.control_is_mildly_elevated: the block-permuted control is 16/46 vs 11.5 expected at chance ~ 1.5 sigma, p ~ 0.06 one-sided. It clears the pre-registered < 3x bar but is NOT cleanly at chance, so a small part of the signal survives block permutation. Disclosed, not hidden.
caveats_stated_against_the_verdict.the_two_tests_are_not_independent: the n=12 holdout sentences are a SUBSET of the 46 LOO sentences. The LOO is the more powerful estimate (about 11 training sentences per class vs 3), and its PASS does not erase the holdout FAIL. Reporting both rather than the favourable one.
caveats_stated_against_the_verdict.loo_is_not_a_fresh_sample: LOO reuses the same 46 sentences; it estimates generalization across held-out sentences but not across new documents or domains.

what_this_establishes.claim: on real written prose, which technical entity a sentence is about is decodable from the codec wave at 0.8043 LOO (37/46, 3.2x chance, p=4.75e-15), training-free
what_this_establishes.corrects: an earlier report cited '98.83% filler' from a 3-word template. Real prose measures 98.58% unfilled, and 8.29x MORE codec content than the template. Direction holds; the magnitude was a template artifact.

what_this_does_not_establish.mvp_workload: the MVP path has no typed labels, so this is NOT a validation on the MVP queries
what_this_does_not_establish.cross_domain: single domain (HENRI design prose), K=4, single seed
